checks: Live public catalog loads in mobile Chrome with CORS; no fixture fallback
Unauthenticated admin routes redirect to login
Invalid credentials show an error without creating a browser session
Member role is rejected before any product upload or write
Admin login verifies /auth/me and survives reload; no image URL field
Invalid MIME type and files above 5 MB are rejected before uploading
Failed upload prevents product creation and shows the server error
Multipart file upload precedes JSON save; retry reuses uploaded attachment
Catalog pagination follows nextPage and maps API units/categories
Editing price omits image fields and preserves the current photograph
Removing an existing photo sends the documented remove_image flag
Failed availability update keeps the previous state
Availability uses PATCH /admin/products/{id}, not an invented endpoint
Failed deletion keeps the product visible
Successful deletion updates admin and the open storefront across tabs
Unauthorized writes clear the expired session and return to login
